title: LB Omnichord kit-independent drum activity timing catalogue

repository_contract.design_status: Codex handover data; not yet integrated into repository

design_contract.dedicated_fill_rule: No periodic/autonomous drum fill is embedded in activity level 5; explicit intermezzos live in drum_fills_timing.json.
design_contract.kit_independence: Events contain only tick, logical_role and velocity. Concrete samples/presets/MIDI notes live in kit-specific instrument files.
design_contract.amy_48ppq_rule: All ticks are even and therefore exactly convertible from 96 PPQ to AMY 48 PPQ by integer division by two.
design_contract.tag_capacity_target: Every complete activity pattern is designed to require <=56 percussion onset tags under the current percussion lane capacity.

logical_roles.low_primary: Primary low-frequency pulse/anchor; usually a bass drum but kit mapping owns the sound.
logical_roles.section_accent: Strong bright accent marking a structural point; not a mandatory crash sample.
logical_roles.timeline_primary: Clave/bell/timeline function for styles whose identity needs a repeating timeline.
logical_roles.hand_accent: Hand/electronic accent function such as clap/cowbell depending on kit/style.
logical_roles.electronic_detail: Short synthetic/electronic detail or stutter function.

level_semantics.name: foundation
level_semantics.meaning: Minimal defining pulse/timeline. Should identify meter/style without sounding empty.

level_semantics.name: normal
level_semantics.meaning: Normal accompaniment density; adds the main timekeeper/texture.

level_semantics.name: active
level_semantics.meaning: Adds pickups, openings, secondary pulses or hand-percussion details.

level_semantics.name: maximum activity
level_semantics.meaning: Adds ghost, accent or auxiliary detail while remaining a repeating groove, not a fill.
